title: CIS 560 Homework 3 Learning and Pre-MILCOM Completion
goal: Complete CIS 560 Homework 3 correctly and preferably submit it before MILCOM travel on October 11, 2026, while using the assignment as high-value midterm preparation. Operate in LEARNING mode by default so Adam owns the key CFG, PDA, and CFL-pumping decisions; switch to explicit COMPLETION mode only if deadline/workload pressure requires it, without treating tutor-generated work as mastery.
acceptance_criteria: The exact Fall 2026 HW3 contract remains authoritative and all four problem blocks are completed against the current assignment, not historical 2019 answers.
Problem 3-4 is handled first in LEARNING mode: Adam selects legal uvxyz decompositions and can explain all three CFL-pumping conditions for the assigned strings.

Problem 3-3 reaches a correct nondeterministic PDA architecture, with Adam able to explain the OR-branch, stack strategy, and full-input acceptance behavior; a final JFLAP artifact is produced if required for submission.

A correct word-processed HW3 submission artifact is produced and validated if the assignment requires one; Canvas submission itself remains a user action unless explicitly authorized by an available submission tool.
The assignment is completed/submission-ready before the Sunday October 11 MILCOM flight whenever reasonably possible, so substantive academic work is not carried into the conference.
HW3 work feeds the living midterm plan without conflating assignment completion with exam readiness.
